entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the applicant after arguing for sometime seeks to withdraw the present M.Cr.C.
for regular bail and only pressing for temporary bail.
Accordingly, present M.Cr.C. for regular bail is dismissed as withdrawn.

2. The applicant has been arrested on 04.04.2025 in connection with Crime No.54/2023 registered at Police Station - Gautam Nagar, District Bhopal for the offence punishable under Sections 363,
376(3) of IPC and Section 3/4 & 16/17 of POCSO Act.
3. It is submitted by learned counsel for applicant that the applicant is suffering from anemia disease, hemoglobin of applicant is 5.9 and required blood transfusion
In this regard, medical documents has been filed by the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:42495 2 MCRC-30301-2025 applicant.
Therefore, it is prayed that applicant be enlarged on temporary bail for further treatment and hospitalization.
4. Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, temporary bail application is allowed and applicant be released on temporary bail till 05.10.2025.

5. It is directed that the applicant be released on temporarily bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount Ajay @ Udham @ Prashant Kushwaha @ Udham @ ... vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 3 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/114666875/
1 to the satisfaction of the Trial Court.

sentences.text: 6. It is directed that applicant shall surrender immediately on 06.10.2025 before the concerned trial Court.

Counsel for the applicant is also directed that when applicant will surrender before concerned Competent Magistrate, certified copy of the order sheet of the concerned Competent Magistrate regarding his surrender shall be filed by him.
Further, the surrender report of the applicant shall be submitted by the concerned Competent Magistrate to the Registry of this Court for information.
7. It is also directed that if applicant fails to surrender on the said date, the concerned Competent Magistrate shall take appropriate steps for securing his arrest.
8. Accordingly, the bail application is disposed off.
